summary.text: Dante Pittman is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 24 who assumed office on January 1, 2025, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as grants consultant and his service in the North Carolina Army National Guard as beginning in December 2015.

paragraphs.text: Pittman was born in Wilson, North Carolina, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2018, and his career experience includes work as a grant manager and human relations director.
As of 2024, Ballotpedia lists his affiliations as the Wilson Education Partnership, the Wilson County Community Foundation, WhirliDogs and OIC of Wilson.
Pittman succeeded Republican Ken Fontenot in House District 24, which the General Assembly lists as covering Nash and Wilson counties.

He serves on the House Appropriations, Commerce and Economic Development, and Emergency Management and Disaster Recovery committees and on the Appropriations Subcommittee on Capital and Information Technology.
